rundown: Pacers beat Knicks 106-104 at Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis, IN in front of 17,274. Pacers led 58-49 at the half and held on. The 2nd quarter decided it: Pacers won it 32-22. Their win chance dropped as low as 11% along the way.
Leading the way — Knicks: Jalen Brunson 33 pts, 11 ast; Karl-Anthony Towns 15 reb. Pacers: Pascal Siakam 19 pts; Andrew Nembhard 6 ast; Ivica Zubac 13 reb.
Where Pacers won it: they won the boards 50-43.

Against the closing line (DraftKings): Knicks closed as 7.5-point favorites and lost outright to Pacers; Pacers won as the underdog at +259; the total closed at 218.5 and they combined for 210, under by 8.5.

review.body:

Projected to score 104.6, they scored 106 (+1.4 points, 1% over); projected to allow 115, they allowed 104 (−11 points, 10% under).

The bigger miss was Knicks' scoring (-11 points against projection).
